title: hep-simbench: validation and benchmarking of a fast simulation against its stock simulation
description: hep-simbench scores a fast simulation against its stock (full) simulation on the same generated events: histogram validity against a reseeded-stock floor, yields with tolerances and a statistical-power rule, an optional classifier score, peak fits, track agreement and portability ratios, in both float32 and float64; plus throughput per grid slot from a warm-rate timer, an approximation registry with provenance records, and Codabench bundles.
